up: Retrieve activity data for the target CHEMBL1980 (human sodium channel protein type 5 subunit alpha). Filter for activities where the standard type is IC50 and standard units are nM. Return the following columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures), pubmed_id (from docs, fallback to doi if pubmed_id is null), assay_description (from assays), and target_pref_name (from target_dictionary). Ensure the target name matches 'Sodium channel protein type 5 subunit alpha'.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  a.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_pref_name,
  act.standard_value AS ic50_nM
FROM activities act
JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1980'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_units = 'nM'
